# Job-site fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

Every file here was written by hand for tests. None was captured from LinkedIn, Indeed or Naukri.com
(the cloud test environment cannot reach those sites, and their terms forbid scraping). The markup is
shaped after the public structure of those pages and alert emails as of late 2026: schema.org
JobPosting JSON-LD, the known job URL patterns, and a few long-standing element ids and classes.
Real pages and emails change often, which is why the adapters are marked `untested_live`.

Companies, people and job ids are fictional ("(synthetic)").
